name: Sigil of Strom
summary: The Sigil of Strom is one of the seals protecting Trol'kalar in Trollbane's tomb. Zengu of Hammerfall seeks it among the Syndicate in Stromgarde.

sections.title: A Stromgarde Sigil
sections.body: The Syndicate took one of the sigils that guard Trol'kalar, the ancient troll-slaying sword. Zengu of Hammerfall needs it as the first step in gathering the seals protecting the blade in Trollbane's tomb.

faq.q: What is the Sigil of Strom?
faq.answer: The Sigil of Strom is one of several seals protecting Trol'kalar in Trollbane's tomb.

faq.q: Who wants the Sigil of Strom?
faq.answer: Zengu in Hammerfall seeks the Sigil of Strom to begin gathering the seals that protect Trol'kalar.

faq.q: Where can I find the Sigil of Strom?
faq.answer: The Syndicate took the Sigil of Strom, and one of its agents in Stromgarde carries it.

faq.q: Why does Zengu need the sigil?
faq.answer: The sigil is one of several seals Zengu needs to remove Trol'kalar from Trollbane's tomb.
Trol'kalar is an ancient sword whose name means troll-slayer in the trolls' tongue. Lord Ignaeus of Strom, called Trollbane, wielded it in battle.
